blocker.statement: The current first-party stadium chart does not print a seat identifier in every drawn row. Seat numbers are printed only against shared marker columns at a small number of rows per block, and 列番号 are printed only at interval rows. The great majority of drawn rows carry neither a seat number nor a row label of their own.
blocker.whyThisIsNotCompletable: Establishing the seat identifiers of an unlabelled row from this chart requires exactly the operations this task and docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md prohibit: propagation from a neighbouring row, completion from the marker band, completion from aligned boundaries, completion from equal cell counts, geometry, symmetry or pitch reasoning, interpolation, or capacity and subtotal fitting. Row identity of an unlabelled row is likewise obtainable only by counting rows between two printed 列番号, which is geometric inference.
